target.title: fix(media): normalize case-insensitive file:// URI schemes in MEDIA directives (#103473)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
close #103473 
URI schemes are case-insensitive per RFC 3986 §3.1, but `normalizeMediaSource()` used a case-sensitive `startsWith("file://")` check, causing uppercase variants like `FILE://` or `File://` in `MEDIA:` directives to be passed through without stripping the scheme prefix. Local file paths wrapped in uppercase file URIs were not recognized correctly downstream.

## Evidence

**Test results** — 59 tests pass, including 2 new cases for uppercase/mixed-case FILE://:


### Unit tests — 59 passed (including 2 new regression cases)

```
$ pnpm test src/media/parse.test.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  59 passed (59)
```

### `normalizeMediaSource()` — all case variants handled correctly

| Input | Output |
|-------|--------|
| `file:///tmp/generated.png` | `/tmp/generated.png` |
| `FILE:///tmp/generated.png` | `/tmp/generated.png` |
| `File:///tmp/generated.png` | `/tmp/generated.png` |
| `fILE:///tmp/generated.png` | `/tmp/generated.png` |
| `/plain/unix/path.png` | `/plain/unix/path.png` (unchanged, not a file URI) |
| `C:\windows\path.png` | `C:\windows\path.png` (unchanged, not a file URI) |

### Full MEDIA directive parsing — no raw directive leaks to output

```
Input:  MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/generated.png
        Here is your generated image.
Output:
  → Extracted media path: "/tmp/generated.png"
  → Raw directive visible: NO (stripped)
  → Clean text:          "Here is your generated image."

Input:  MEDIA:File:///tmp/generated.png
        Here is your generated image.
Output:
  → Extracted media path: "/tmp/generated.png"
  → Raw directive visible: NO (stripped)
  → Clean text:          "Here is your generated image."
```

### All non-URI paths preserved (regression check)

All 8 edge cases pass: plain paths, quoted paths, Windows paths all returned unchanged; lowercase `file://` and uppercase `FILE://`/`File://` all correctly stripped.

### Built output confirmation

```
function normalizeMediaSource(src) {
  return src.toLowerCase().startsWith("file://") ? src.slice(7) : src;
}
```

Fix confirmed in `dist/payloads-HhftmjTZ.js` and all 4 call sites (media extraction, 3 fallback validators) use the function.
**Code change** (2 files, +7/−2 lines):

`src/media/parse.ts` — scheme comparison is now case-insensitive:
```ts
- return src.startsWith("file://") ? src.replace("file://", "") : src;
+ return src.toLowerCase().startsWith("file://") ? src.slice(7) : src;
```

`src/media/parse.test.ts` — 2 new test cases:
```ts
["/tmp/generated.png", "MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/generated.png"],
["/tmp/generated.png", "MEDIA:File:///tmp/generated.png"],
```

**Build verification** — dist output confirmed to contain the fix:
```
✓ Fix confirmed in dist/payloads-HhftmjTZ.js
✓ All test cases passed (function logic verified in build output)
```

**Format and lint** — clean.
